stories.title: NFL looking into official apparently cursing at Cards TE McBride
stories.summary: The NFL says it is reviewing an official's apparent use of profanity directed at Cardinals tight end Trey McBride in Sunday's game against the Giants.

stories.title: Sources: Thornton dislocates ankle in win, Chiefs 'in contact' with Tyreek
stories.summary: Kansas City Chiefs wide receiver Tyquan Thornton, injured in his team in Sunday's 30-27 victory over the Las Vegas Raiders, suffered a dislocated ankle that was put back into place by doctors, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: Braves steal Game 2 without Sale to even NLDS with Dodgers
stories.summary: Michael Harris II tripled and scored the go-ahead run on reliever Kris Bubic's wild pitch in the fifth inning, and the Braves beat the Dodgers 3-2 on Sunday night.

stories.title: 'Everything just clicked' with McMillan, Young in Panthers' primetime win
stories.summary: Carolina receiver Tetairoa McMillan was dominant in his team's 32-36 win over Detroit Lions Sunday night, catching 14 passes for 192 yards and two touchdowns from teammate Bryce Young, who threw for 329 yards to help the Panthers even their record at 2-2.

stories.title: Chargers' Harbaugh standing by OC McDaniel: 'Job is not in jeopardy'
stories.summary: After another poor offensive performance Sunday, Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh is standing by offensive coordinator Mike McDaniel.
